## Write-risk update tool, proposal only
Validates a batch of field updates for existing prospects (fill LinkedIn company URLs, correct contacts, change status) and stores them as a pending action. Nothing changes until the user replies with the exact confirmation phrase, checked by 40 - CONFIRM - Task Write, which then dispatches 74.

Allowed fields: linkedinCompanyUrl, contactName, contactEmail, linkedinUrl, website, region, tier, status, notes. At most 100 updates per proposal.
